title: Bunny → armadillo
description: Downloaded research scans rebuilt as shared-index triangle meshes. Grid resolution reduces fine detail; this is a field morph, not semantic feature matching.
credits: Stanford University Computer Graphics Laboratory. Research and free redistribution with attribution; commercial use requires permission. https://graphics.stanford.edu/data/3Dscanrep/

title: Rounded two → five split
description: Rounded separating necks with one spherical light and reflections. Final shapes include two tori and a tetrahedron. Volume preservation remains unfinished.

title: Two → five · earlier split
description: Earlier version for comparison: sharper split borders, spherical lighting and floor reflections.

title: Three-state cubic morph
description: Sphere → rounded cube → ellipsoid, using cubic state interpolation with smooth start and end.

title: Walking cat · 48 fps
description: Every second source frame retained; native VKF generates the intermediate frames. Fast-motion ghosting remains.
credits: Cat photo: Anton Petrov; dog photo: Karen Arnold; walking-cat video: Dzkouslavia. CC0.

title: Walking cat · comparison
description: Original 24 fps, retained 12 fps, and reconstructed 48 fps. New timestamps are inferred, not recovered ground truth.
credits: Cat photo: Anton Petrov; dog photo: Karen Arnold; walking-cat video: Dzkouslavia. CC0.

title: Cat · small internal motion
description: Known small synthetic motion tests whether local image structure follows the deformation.
credits: Cat photo: Anton Petrov; dog photo: Karen Arnold; walking-cat video: Dzkouslavia. CC0.

title: Cat → dog
description: A connected texture mesh transforms one photo into another. Eye and muzzle correspondence remains imperfect.
credits: Cat photo: Anton Petrov; dog photo: Karen Arnold; walking-cat video: Dzkouslavia. CC0.

title: Rotation and photo morph
description: The photo morph combines with a prescribed 25° rotation. Semantic correspondence limitations remain.
credits: Cat photo: Anton Petrov; dog photo: Karen Arnold; walking-cat video: Dzkouslavia. CC0.

title: Area and thin geometry
description: Comparison from the thin-stroke and cavity-timing review. This is recorded benchmark evidence.

title: Morphology regression review
description: Review of the corrected morphology corpus, including changing object counts and routing.

title: Branching objects
description: Branching and changing-cohort motion from the earlier geometry experiments.

title: Geometry · before and after
description: Earlier before/after comparison of shape transport and hole handling.
